events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: He's not the Messiah, he's a very naughty boy! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled "The Beatles," widely known as the "White Album," was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, the 'White Album'. Still sounds as fresh and inventive today as it did in '68.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A legend, always.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game. Still a masterpiece of songwriting and innovation.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980 at the age of 40. He would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Forever missed.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The music legend David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie, an unparalleled artist who constantly reinvented himself and left an indelible mark on music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his voice still commands attention like no other. A true icon.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page. The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are still sending shivers down spines.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still sailing strong at 82! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart, a rock and roll legend with a voice that's instantly recognisable.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Our house, in the middle of our street... it's Suggs' 66th birthday! Wishing a very happy one to the frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: He's come a long way, baby! Happy 71st birthday to the wonderful Paul Young, still 'Everytime You Go Away' we miss that voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5, and still fabulous at 81! Happy birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton, a true national treasure.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got that magic touch! Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow. What's your favourite Gary-penned hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Grammy-winning British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and celebrate Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! Wishing a fantastic day to the soul legend.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989, honouring pioneers of the genre.

angles.name: Rock Hall Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty gathered for the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be your first pick for the Hall?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Still looking for a 'Shine'! Happy 55th birthday to the eternally youthful Mark Owen from Take That. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their final live show. An iconic moment in music history, still giving us chills.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Against all odds, he's 76! Happy birthday to the legendary Phil Collins, a drumming powerhouse and a chart-topping vocalist.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Is it still raining? We hadn't noticed. Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British charmer, Hugh Grant.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose legacies live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up... or forget your birthday! Happy 61st to the one and only Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rickroll moment?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, and his message of peace and unity still resonates globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: You've got a friend in us! Happy 85th birthday to the incomparable Carole King, a true songwriting genius.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away in 2012 at the age of 48. She would have been 64.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and iconic songs continue to inspire. Forever missed.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: Twenty-one years ago, pop sensations Take That announced their initial split, devastating fans across the UK.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember where you were? Twenty-one years ago today, Take That announced their split, breaking hearts nationwide. Thankfully, they came back stronger!
